breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The original prompt had a conflicting final time `T=1.1` which was outside the specified domain `t in [0, 1.0]`. The ground truth corrected this by changing the final time to `T=1.0`. The agent failed to resolve this conflict and instead used the incorrect final time from the original prompt, stating "With T=1.1, compute Nt = ceil(T/dt0)...". This repeats the error instead of correcting it.
